# `RegressionFailed`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\RegressionFailed`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/RegressionFailed.php#L15) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** [`Runner\PropertyResult`](/api/classes/Runner/PropertyResult)

A recorded regression (a values corpus entry) failed again on replay. The
input was already minimal when recorded, so it is reported verbatim.

## Methods

### failure()

```php
failure(): Throwable
```

The engine exception describing the failure — the same type and message
the package has always reported ([`PropertyViolationException`](/api/classes/PropertyViolationException)
for a falsification, and so on). Null for a pass.
